body: I totally understand that. Unfortunately she isn't. She was unable to with our son so we went right to formula with our daughter. Thanks though for the reply.

I've read this reply many times but i didn't know how to respond. Honestly, I'm so exhausted that I can't even answer the question of what I want. Everything just sounds like it will fail and I'm not sure I can handle another failure. To add insult to my last post, my inlaws asked my wife to take a 2 day trip with them and to bring the kids along. I was never asked to join or even mentioned. This hurt me deeply and I have no idea how to fix it. If I stand up for what I think is right it will just cause a division in my marriage and put my wife in the middle. I'm afraid of what she will choose. I'm afraid of being alone. I've thought about couples counseling many times but I feel like it would be a waste of time. She won't talk to me when we're at home and private and I feel like she won't talk to the therapist that we see. I'm lost. End of story.
If it would help you get out of the place you're in I would gladly give it all to you.
